annotations.title: List, add or remove a track's reminders

description: A reminder nudges the person on their phone or browser at a time of day, on some days of the week, to add a row ("Log your weight"), with a button that opens the form with some answers filled in. action list shows a track's reminders; add makes one (label, days, time, and preset, skipIfLogged or summary); remove takes one away by its reminderId from list.

days.description: add: days of the week, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.

label.description: add: what it says, like "Log your weight".

preset.description: add: answers to fill in, by column key.

skipIfLogged.description: add: quiet on a day something was already added.

summary.description: add: send a short summary of the sheet instead.

time.description: add: the time of day in the person's timezone, as HH:MM, like 08:30.

name: reminders
title: List, add or remove a track's reminders
